 Oral Order

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.P.P. for the State and learned counsel for complainant / opp. party no. 2.
2. The petitioner who is husband of opposite party No. 2, apprehends his arrest in a complaint case punishable for the offences under Sections 498A, 323 of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Petitioner is alleged to have committed torture and harassment to opposite party no. 2 for dowry.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner offers and undertakes that he is ready to give maintenance amount of Rs. 3,000/- per month, starting from this Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.16807 of 2024(3) dt.14-05-2024 month, to opposite party no. 2.
5.

In view of the undertaking of learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is ready to give maintenance amount of Rs. 3,000/- (three thousand) per month to the opposite party no. 2, in the event of arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, let the above-named petitioner be Jahangir Khan vs The State Of Bihar on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6681156/
1 enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M., Motihari, East Champaran / concerned court in connection with Complaint Case No. 241/2022, subject to the conditions laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure as well as on the following conditions:-
"(1) Opposite party No. 2 would file an affidavit before the court below and bring on record her savings bank account number for its communication to the petitioner.

(2)
Petitioner would deposit the aforesaid maintenance amount per month in the savings bank account of the opposite party No. 2.
(3) In case, the petitioner fails to deposit the maintenance amount for two consecutive months, the court below would be at liberty to cancel the bail-bond.

(4) The aforementioned payment will be subject to Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.16807 of 2024(3) dt.14-05-2024 any order passed in matrimonial, maintenance or connected proceedings.
The present order, in no way, will preclude the parties to resolve the issue otherwise."
